Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in recalling or estimating the physical properties of the materials involved. Specifically, it incorrectly assigned a density of ~1.3 g/cm³ to feathers (which is closer to the density of water or soft tissue, not loose feathers) and a density of ~0.8 g/cm³ to iron nails (which is drastically lower than the actual density of iron, ~7.87 g/cm³). This led to the false conclusion that feathers are heavier than iron for the same volume. The correct logic relies on the fact that iron is significantly denser than air/loose feathers, meaning 1 liter of iron nails will have a much greater mass than 1 liter of feathers.
